name: Peanut the Squirrel
scope_note: Solana pump.fun memecoin. It is not a stablecoin, wrapper, staked, RWA or leveraged token. First credible listing was Binance spot on 2024-11-11 (OKX listTime 1731318000000 = 2024-11-11), so it is well over 90 days.

D1.value: Top 10 non-excluded holders hold >=49.35% of circulating if only the Binance wallet 9WzD is excluded. That is ranks 2-10, 493.4M of 999.84M, plus rank 11, which I couldn't read. This fails the 35% cap unless 51yZ, 3gd3, 3B7X, CBEA, 4xLp and GBrU get explorer labels as exchange wallets. They hold 4.78M, 6.44M, 128k, 2.45M, 630k and 357k SOL, so they look custodial, but none has a label I could read. Under D5 the result is need-more-info.
D1.source: GoPlus solana token_security holders; balances re-read via Solana RPC getMultipleAccounts (slot 470180991)

D2.value: Largest non-excluded holder is 51yZyDSnec4xnUv7XLRVYcDyV4x3wUtzrDcRaYbmQU5j with 105,889,466 (10.59%). That is above 10%, so it fails unless the wallet is labelled an exchange. It is a System wallet holding 4.78M SOL. No public label was found (Solscan is behind Cloudflare, Arkham is blocked, and web search returns nothing).
D2.source: Solana RPC getMultipleAccounts on token account 7yycozU6arMskB3btkKR2wnMWwdq5L6JBigGhTeEKKpm and on the owner

D3.value: No labelled insider wallets. The pump.fun dev wallet HrHJ...SUcf holds 0.0000466% per Jupiter. But six unidentified wallets each hold >=2%, 42.20% in total, and they count as insiders under D5. That is above 20%, so the test fails if they stay unidentified.
D3.source: Jupiter tokens v2 audit.devBalancePercentage; GoPlus holders; Solana RPC

D4.value: Wallet flows to exchange deposit addresses over the last 90 days were not traced. That needs a labelled transfer history, and Solscan's API is behind Cloudflare.

D5.value: Six non-excluded wallets at >=2% are unidentified: 51yZ 10.59%, 3gd3 9.76%, 3B7X 7.03%, CBEA 5.08%, 4xLp 5.06%, GBrU 4.68%. Per D5 they count as insiders and change the D1/D2/D3 outcome, which means need-more-info rather than reject.
D5.source: GoPlus holders + Solana RPC + web search for addresses (no hits)

E1.value: 0%. Mint authority is null, so no new supply is possible, and there are no vesting, treasury or emissions.
E1.source: Solana RPC getAccountInfo on the mint (api.mainnet-beta.solana.com and solana-rpc.publicnode.com, slot 470180755)

E2.value: 0% new supply in 180 days. Mint authority is null.
E2.source: Solana RPC getAccountInfo on the mint

E3.value: Circulating = total = 999,840,620.94, which is 100% of total and 99.98% of the 1B max. The gap is supply that was burned and can never be minted again.
E3.source: Solana RPC mint supply; Jupiter circSupply/totalSupply

E4.value: The schedule is known: no unlocks are possible, because supply is fixed and mint authority is null.
E4.source: Solana RPC getAccountInfo on the mint

F1.value: Classic SPL mint owned by TokenkegQfeZyiNwAJbNbGKPFXCWuBvf9Ss623VQ5DA (the standard SPL Token program). There is no token-specific code.

F3.value: No privileged roles. Mint and freeze authority are null. GoPlus reports balance_mutable_authority 0, closable 0, metadata_mutable 0 (no update authority), transfer_fee_upgradable 0 and transfer_hook_upgradable 0. GoPlus Solana has no owner_address or can_take_back_ownership fields.

F4.value: No per-token proxy. It is a plain mint account under the shared SPL Token program. The SPL program's own upgrade authority was not checked.

F5.value: freezeAuthority null. GoPlus freezable 0, default_account_state 1 (initialized, not frozen), default_account_state_upgradable 0. No blacklist or pause primitive.

F6.value: Classic Tokenkeg, so no Token-2022 extensions. GoPlus transfer_fee {}, transfer_hook [], non_transferable 0.
F6.source: GoPlus solana token_security; Solana RPC owner program

F7.value: No honeypot or cannot-sell flag. GoPlus Solana returns no is_honeypot/cannot_sell_all fields, and non_transferable is 0. honeypot.is doesn't cover Solana. Two-way trading is live: Raydium 4AZR 24h volume $68.8k per GoPlus, and Coinbase PNUT-USD is online.

F8.value: Raydium AMM v4 pool 4AZRPNEfCJ7iw28rJu5aUyeQhYcvdcNm8cswyL51AY9i holds $2.109M of ~$2.115M on-chain liquidity (~99.7%; Jupiter total liquidity $2.105M). 99.68% of its LP tokens are burned (pump.fun graduation burn). The other ~0.32% of LP (about $6.7k) is not burned. No other pool holds >=20%.
F8.source: GoPlus solana token_security dex[]; Jupiter tokens v2

F9.value: Unmodified SPL token with mint authority revoked (and freeze revoked).

G1.value: Binance PNUTUSDT, PNUTTRY and PNUTUSDC are TRADING with tags [Meme, Solana, Seed] and no Monitoring tag. Bybit is Trading with stTag 0, Coinbase online, OKX live, Kraken online. Search found no delisting announcement.
G1.source: Binance bapi get-products; Bybit v5 instruments; Coinbase market/products; OKX public/instruments; Kraken AssetPairs; web search

G2.value: No exploit of the token. The mint has no contract surface and there is no bridge holding >=10%.

G3.value: No regulator enforcement found. The matters found are all private: Longo's Dec-2024 cease-and-desist to Binance and his threats to sue exchanges, and the Burwick class action against pump.fun that names PNUT sales. The top 10 holders are not on the OFAC SDN list. Ranks 11-20 could not be read because getTokenLargestAccounts returned 429 or needed a key on every public RPC, so the sanctions check is incomplete.
G3.source: OFAC sdn.csv grep; web search; Solana RPC attempts

G4.source: web search; Jupiter tokens v2 (single mint, graduatedPool 4AZR)
